why: The small oval moves around the inside of the circle anticlockwise: top, then left, then bottom. The next place is the right side. Option 3 is the only one with the oval on the right side. Option 4 keeps it at the bottom, which is the last figure again.
trick: A dot or oval moving round a circle keeps the same direction; check clockwise or anticlockwise.
note: In the scan the oval in option 3 sits at the lower right, not exactly at the right side, but it is the only option on the right.
